messages:
sana (product): PharmaPilot wants an MVP Optimize alpha for their pilot in 4 weeks: tenant-aware quant recommendations, nightly eval-triggered alerts on a clinical prompt set, audit records, and no automatic rollouts. Can we scope this?

mike (swe): Target Dedicated eu-west only for alpha to limit infra. API-only delivery (no UI) keeps it to ~2 sprints.

leila (ml): Proposed ML flow: sample ~1-2k clinical prompts, run baseline + candidate quant variants, score with clinical entity F1 and perplexity, then surface top-2 quant profiles with latency/cost estimates.

omar (solutions): Customer mandate: every recommendation must have an auditable record (baseline eval id, new eval id, recommended quant tag, short rationale). Also they insist on opt-out.

mike (swe): Alerting plan: nightly eval runner -> rule comparator -> if trigger -> emit alert event -> deliver to internal ops, tenant webhook, and email. Aim for alert delivery <10m.

leila (ml): Alpha trigger thresholds suggestion: entity F1 drop >= 2% absolute OR perplexity increase >= 8% plus latency win >= 20% -> produce recommendation. Include a 2-3 sentence rationale in payload.

sana (product): Acceptance criteria for alpha: nightly evals run and store metrics; alerts emitted <10m; audit entry persisted with required fields; opt-out respected; docs + runbook exist.

omar (solutions): I'll draft customer-facing language clarifying "advisory-only" recommendations. No auto-apply for alpha.

mike (swe): Example payload we'll send as JSON in the alert:
{
  "tenant": "pharmapilot",
  "eval_ts": "2026-03-01T03:00:00Z",
  "metric_deltas": "{\"entity_f1\": -0.025, \"ppl\": 0.09}",
  "recommended_quant": "q4_8x",
  "est_latency_ms": "{\"p50\": 28, \"p95\": 52, \"p99\": 70}",
  "rationale": "Entity F1 dropped on named clinical entities; q4_8x reduces p99 by ~25% with small expected quality impact."
}

leila (ml): ML will upload the eval set and baseline hashes within 48h.

mike (swe): Eng can deliver API-only alpha in ~3 weeks with a focused 1-SWE sprint. Need a ticket with deps.

sana (product): Approve alpha scope (API-only, audit logs, nightly evals, opt-out)? React with :white_check_mark: / :x: in thread.

mike (swe): :white_check_mark:

leila (ml): :white_check_mark:

omar (solutions): :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Branch created: feature/optimize-pharmapilot-alpha. CI kicked off.

sana (product): Next steps: Mike open eng ticket today; Leila upload evals; Omar draft customer note; I'll schedule kickoff with PharmaPilot. If no objections I'll convert to tickets.
